scope: Owned WebVTT read/parse/caption lifecycle and persistent color map in the experimental document path. Full repository Rust migration remains active.

operations.operation: Magic, header, style, time, caption and emission lifecycle
operations.behavior: Rust owns raw lines, header/start/end tokens, cue tags, style buffer, captions, previous caption/header, found-first-cue flag, time arithmetic and read/parse decisions. Magic ignores the first read result. Ordinary outer and caption loops discard false-read fragments; a style-loop EOF fragment is reused as a header without trimming. Style blank means counted empty, so whitespace-only style lines continue. Closed comment deletion retains the final slash. A valid first cue permanently disables style-block detection. Time scans short-circuit; count5 shifts three numbers, count7 uses four, and arithmetic wraps i64. Consecutive duplicates require CString-prefix equality of both caption and full header. Caption concatenation suppresses the added newline after a source NUL.

A Rust BTreeMap of raw UTF16 keys owns all 16 default classes and subsequent CSS results. Each update replaces both foreground and background, with no merge; an empty pair is ignored. Immutable map snapshots are copied into a temporary native map only for one WebVTT2SSA call; applied flags and markup stacks are conversion-local. No canonical native map survives a parser request.

ReadString, CString whitespace, exact swscanf_s buffers/conversions, original CSS regular expressions and stoi, WebVTT2SSA formatting and Add run outside registry loans. Only initialized time locals cross the boundary. The CSS extractor preserves last-default selection, named-class traversal and color parsing, and sends each update to Rust. The fallback parser remains unchanged and in migration scope.

boundary_review.contract: Typed never-reused document-bound IDs under nonblocking registry admission. Read/packet spans are copied before borrowing state. Strict booleans, counted raw-unit packet sizes, scanf ranges, initialized scalar values, command values and phases are checked before mutation. Output capacity is checked before publication. Snapshots are immutable and survive parent/session destruction. No native file, buffer, map or callback pointer is retained.
boundary_review.tests: Malformed packets, raw surrogate/NUL preservation, phase errors, BUSY, typed/stale IDs, output preflight, caller mutation, snapshot lifetime, style EOF reuse, whitespace-only style input, comment deletion, whole-entry color replacement, time short-circuit and duplicate cues.

direct_probe.method: Actual selected STS.cpp implementations with initialized document observer. Two reference and two candidate executions compare outcomes, document state and byte position. Empty/preloaded documents, magic casing/placement, malformed and overflowing time scans, CSS ordering, comments, class replacement, duplicate cues, ANSI/DBCS, raw units and EOF fragments are included. No crashing, hanging, exceptional or nondeterministic run is treated as a successful comparison.

rendering.behavior: File/memory opens, timestamp boundaries, repeated/backward seeks, class replacement, alignment, RGB colors, style-arrow recovery, comments, duplicates, post-cue styles, dropped final fragments and NUL/surrogate input. Class replacement/control and alignment/control images must differ.

limits: No production default switch, format closure, real player/Aegisub graph integration or repository completion.
Native file, CString locale predicates, CRT scans, CSS regex/stoi, WebVTT2SSA, Add and host adapters remain transitional.
Finite local MSVC14.44 Windows evidence. File I/O failure injection, native regex/stoi exceptions, pre-Open simplicity and allocation failure/reentry remain unresolved.
No new non-Windows/Miri/default native-document runtime parity; fallback paths have compile evidence only.
No crash, hang or nondeterministic reference outcome is treated as equality. Existing raw fallback adapters, renderer, all public hosts and vendored code remain in the full migration scope.
next_work: Continue remaining format ownership: SubViewer, USF and RealText. SubViewer source has uninitialized style booleans before a style declaration and a param+2 color read; triage reference outcomes before choosing safe emulation, without treating crashes or nondeterminism as passes.
Replace native numeric, encoding, formatting and file adapters with audited system boundaries and safe policy.
Continue complete rendering, public host/ABI and vendored native replacement; retire fallback/raw adapters as callers move.
